declarations.name: AuiSignaturePad
declarations.description:
AbsoluteUI SignaturePad: `<aui-signature-pad>`.
Implements ControlValueAccessor and Validator (error key `aui`); `[(value)]` without forms.

inputs.name: description
inputs.description: Help text, referenced by the pad group and the typed field.

inputs.name: penColor
inputs.description: Pen color (CSS color); default the --aui-signature-pad-ink token.

inputs.name: typedFont
inputs.description: Font family for typed signatures (default a cursive family).

inputs.name: submit
inputs.description: Hidden input format: 'png' or 'svg' data URL.

inputs.name: readOnly
inputs.description: Show the signature without editing controls.

inputs.name: name
inputs.description: Form field name (hidden input with the data URL).

inputs.name: validate
inputs.description: Consumer validation; return a message to mark the value invalid.

inputs.name: penWidth
inputs.description: Base stroke width in CSS pixels (0.5 to 20).

models.name: value
models.description: The value: `[(value)]` without forms; with Angular forms, bind the form control instead.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: After a stroke, a typed change, undo, clear, or a mode switch: { value, validity }.

properties.name: formState
properties.description: Angular form state of this control.

methods.name: toDataURL
methods.description: PNG (device pixel ratio, transparent) or SVG data URL.

methods.name: getFormValue
methods.description: The submitted data URL, or null when empty.

methods.name: setCustomError
methods.description: Show or clear an external error.

methods.name: reportValidity
methods.description: Show messages now and return validity.

methods.name: focus
methods.description: Focus the mode buttons (draw) or the typed field (type).

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Restore the initial value and clear the validation state.

accessibility.pattern: A labelled group with a Draw/Type pair of toggle buttons (aria-pressed), the canvas as role=img whose name describes its content, a native text field for the typed-name alternative, and undo and clear buttons. Drawing is pointer-only, so the typed mode provides the keyboard and screen-reader path (WCAG 2.1.1, 2.5.7).

limitations: The default ink color is read when drawing; after a theme change, a resize or update() redraws with the new color.
Exported PNGs have a transparent background.
